question: What ritual action must follow the completion of oblation and related rites?
premises: Oblation and related rites are fully performed
The sequence continues after their completion
Gaṅgā is the object of the subsequent act
inference: After completing all oblation rites, one should invoke Gaṅgā.
plain_english: Having performed all the oblations and related rites, one should then invoke Gaṅgā.
